candidates.title: Administrator document filing checklist

demandEvidence.chore: Handle and register administrative documents for filing, with an AI draft label and a person confirming each category.

ease.reason: A spreadsheet and sample documents can start a filing checklist, but the notice gives no document types.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: small professional offices may pay for less filing work; AI-service demand is unproved.

feasibility.reason: A two-week mock can label operator-supplied sample documents; real archive access and retention rules are unknown.

autonomy.reason: The draft can suggest a category, while a person must verify and file each record.

evidence.reason: The fresh paid notice names filing and registration, but gives no frequency, fields, or workflow detail.

candidates.reason: Assessed; below threshold because document types and routing rules are absent.

feasibility.reason: A two-week mock can check operator-supplied fictional rows; the notice omits columns and payroll rules.

evidence.reason: The fresh paid notice names Excel time-report entry and accuracy, but gives no fields, frequency, or workflow details.

candidates.reason: Repair assessment: a narrowly scoped fictional-row checker is possible, but the corrected five-criterion mean is below 6; the notice supports the chore only, not fields, rules, or AI buyers.
